[SP/FA] Octa 2 Monthly Test 2 Review Sheet
Reading · Unit 3 Lesson 1
Some trees in Mexico and California turn orange in fall.
But it's not because of their leaves.
They are covered with thousands of orange butterflies!
These trees are the winter home of monarch butterflies.

Monarch butterflies live in Canada and the northern U.S.A.
Like some birds, they migrate south to warm places before winter.
They fly to Mexico and California. Then they slow down there.
They don't fly around. They don't look for food. They don't eat.
They just live on their fat.

Also, they stay in large groups. They gather close on trees.
That's how monarch butterflies can stay warm.
That way, they are safe from the cold weather.
1. What is the passage mainly about?
(A) what butterflies do during winter
(B) why butterflies live in trees
(C) how butterflies find food
(D) why butterflies change color
2. When do monarch butterflies migrate south?
(A) before winter
(B) in the spring
(C) before summer
(D) after spring
3. What is NOT true about monarch butterflies during winter?
(A) They live in trees.
(B) They slow down in warm places.
(C) They live on their fat.
(D) They fly to Canada.
4. How do monarch butterflies stay warm during winter?
(A) They go back to the U.S.A.
(B) They eat the trees.
(C) They stay in large groups.
(D) They fly around.
5. What does the underlined sentence mean?
(A) Monarch butterflies live in trees during winter.
(B) Monarch butterflies eat leaves in the winter.
(C) Monarch butterflies make homes after winter.
(D) Monarch butterflies go home for the winter.

Reading · Unit 3 Lesson 2
Interviewer: Thank you for coming to our interview. Can you tell us about yourself?
Bill Lishman: Hi, I’m Bill Lishman from Canada. People call me Father Goose.

Interviewer: Father Goose? That’s a very interesting nickname. Why do they call you that?
Bill Lishman: That’s because I raise a lot of geese.
I take care of them just like my own children.
For example, I take care of what they eat and where they sleep.

Interviewer: But geese need to migrate to the south before winter. How do your geese migrate?
Bill Lishman: I fly a small airplane, and my geese fly close behind me.
I show them the safe way to go to the warm place.
1. Why do people call Bill "Father Goose"?
(A) He raises a lot of geese.
(B) He looks like a goose.
(C) He writes stories about geese.
(D) He teaches people about geese.
2. When do geese migrate?
(A) before spring
(B) after winter
(C) before winter
(D) every season
3. What is true about the geese's migration?
(A) They migrate to the north.
(B) They fly close behind Bill's plane.
(C) Bill shows them the fastest way to go.
(D) They fly to a cold place with Bill.
4. What does the underlined sentence mean?
(A) I look after the geese just like my own kids.
(B) My children take care of the geese.
(C) The geese look after my children.
(D) I take care of the geese better than my own kids.

[SP/FA] Octa 2 Monthly Test 2 Review Sheet
Reading · Unit 4 Lesson 1
Garfield High School was in a poor neighborhood.
Few students there went to university. A good job was just a dream.
But one day, a new math teacher gave the students a goal.

Mr. Escalante told his students they could have a better future.
They had to try hard and do well in class. Then they could go to university.

He made a rule. It was simple but strict.
His students had to do their homework.
They couldn't come to his class without homework. They followed his rule.

His students studied very hard. Most of them passed a very hard exam.
They went to university. Thanks to Mr. Escalante, they reached their goals.
1. What problem did Garfield High School have?
(A) The students didn't have time to study.
(B) No students went to university.
(C) The teachers could not pass hard exams.
(D) Not many students went to university.
2. What did Mr. Escalante teach?
(A) math
(B) football
(C) science
(D) English
3. What did the students have to do before Mr. Escalante's class?
(A) come to class early
(B) study very hard
(C) do their homework
(D) pass every test
4. What did Mr. Escalante make the students do for their goals?
(A) take many hard exams
(B) get a good job
(C) follow a rule
(D) make lots of money
5. What might we know about Mr. Escalante?
(A) He did not like the rules.
(B) He made strict rules for teachers.
(C) He made a very hard exam.
(D) He helped his students study.
